<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def Npos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
def win(): return bool(last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
def over(): return bool(last_action_result.get('game_over'))
print("start",Npos(current_frame))
for i in range(3):
    action(['RIGHT']); print("R",i+1,Npos(current_frame),"win?",win(),"over?",over())
    if over() or win(): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
